table.ruleA: Add each compartment's Fill Table amount for this cycle; volume not enforced (may exceed volume).
table.ruleB: Add each form's charge table amount for this cycle; volume not enforced (may exceed volume).

table.ruleA: Sequential in order 1..6. If contents > volume (strictly), excess goes to n+1 and contents set to volume; equal or less does nothing. Overflow reaches n+1 before n+1 is checked (cascade). Excess from 6 goes to Total Overboard.
table.ruleB: Sequential in order 1..6. If holds > volume (strictly), overtop goes to n+1 and form left at volume; volume or less does nothing. Overtop lands in n+1 before it is handled (cascade). Overtop from 6 goes to waste tally.

table.ruleA: Read contents after Step 2. LAMINAR with contents >= inception mark becomes CAVITATING; CAVITATING with contents <= desinence mark becomes LAMINAR; otherwise unchanged (hysteresis band keeps state). At most one change per cycle; log (cycle, compartment, before, after).
table.ruleB: Read contents after Step 2. GREEN holding >= upper mark becomes HOT; HOT holding <= lower mark becomes GREEN; otherwise unchanged. At most one change per cycle; record (cycle, form, before, after).

table.ruleA: Amounts from contents at start of step, using state just set in Step 3: LAMINAR floor(contents/4), CAVITATING floor(contents/2). All six computed first, then applied simultaneously. Each loses own amount; LAMINAR amount to Overboard; CAVITATING amount added to n-1; compartment 1 CAVITATING amount to Overboard. Volume not enforced.
table.ruleB: Amounts from contents at start of step: GREEN floor(/4), HOT floor(/2). All six computed first, applied together. Each loses own amount; GREEN amount to waste tally; HOT amount added to n-1; form 1 HOT bleed to waste tally. Volume not enforced.

table.ruleA: Sum all six contents after Step 4. If total > 38 (strict; 38 does not fire), every compartment (all six) becomes floor(contents/2); the removed units (contents - floor half) go to Total Overboard; log the cycle.
table.ruleB: Sum all six after Step 4. If total > 38 (strict; 38 or less nothing), every form (all six) becomes floor(contents/2); removed units go to waste tally; record the cycle.

table.ruleA: (a) end contents 1-6, (b) end pump states, (c) all state changes as (cycle, compartment, before, after), (d) blow cycles or 'none', (e) Total Overboard, (f) balance check.
table.ruleB: (a) end mix 1-6, (b) end status, (c) all status changes as (cycle, form, before, after), (d) washout cycles, (e) final waste tally, (f) balance check.
table.difference: Only cosmetic: A explicitly allows 'none' in (d); B does not say so. No functional difference.
